topic: Your next hire read this first

slides.headline: Your next hire read your Glassdoor page before they read your job ad
Candidates check before they apply.
slides.body: Your rating and top reviews are part of the decision to click “apply” at all.

slides.headline: They check again before they sign.
slides.body: The night before an offer deadline is when one bad review does the most damage.

slides.headline: It shows up in Google too.
slides.body: Search your company name plus “reviews” and see what comes back.

slides.headline: A fake 1-star reads like a real one.
slides.body: Candidates can't tell, and won't try.

slides.headline: Senior hires check hardest.
slides.body: The people with the most options read the most closely.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
